title: Representations of infinite species
summary: We consider species, consisting of a possibly infinite set of rings, and bimodules between them. Simson realised the category of representations as a functor category, which we prove is hereditary when each of the rings is semisimple. We use purity to provide sufficient conditions, in order for a representation to decompose into indecomposables with local endomorphism rings. For any bifunctor valued in bimodules, we functorially construct species equipped with commutativity conditions. This generates examples coming from a range of topics, such as subobject lattices in abelian length…
